question: Should OpenClaw standardize the narrow `openclaw commands list/inspect` catalog, and which v1 namespace, JSON fields, and plugin metadata become supported compatibility contracts?
rationale: The RFC is feasible and well proven, but it deliberately leaves permanent namespace, schema stability, plugin API exposure, and Gateway convergence unresolved; repository lifecycle assigns those choices to maintainers before acceptance.

options.title: Ratify narrow Option A
options.body: Accept list and inspect with a minimal stable schema while deferring broader lenses, prompt projection, and full Gateway convergence.

options.title: Select broader Option B
options.body: Adopt a separate catalog namespace and revise the proposal around its larger operator and audit surface.

options.title: Decline unified inventory
options.body: Keep existing command-discovery surfaces separate and stop the dependent implementation stack.

recommendation.title: Ratify narrow Option A
recommendation.body: Accept list and inspect with a minimal stable schema while deferring broader lenses, prompt projection, and full Gateway convergence.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the repository's RFC acceptance workflow and are the strongest history-backed owner for sponsoring the required discussion.
